$description: RealSync Light Experience (RSD & AI). W3C Design Tokens Community Group format. Collections: primitives, semantic (theme modes), component (aliases to semantic only). Default mode is light-cream. Customer Design DNA should add modes on semantic only and must not edit this file.

com.rsd.meta.dna_contract: Override ONLY semantic tokens via extra modes. Do not change primitives or this file. Component tokens resolve through semantic aliases.

primitives.$description: Raw values only. Single mode. Do not override in the customer Design DNA layer.

red.$description: proposed — brief: sparing red highlight (not in PR #2204)

graphite-mid.$description: proposed — warm graphite mid surface, derived from PR #2204 #111720

graphite-soft.$description: proposed — warm graphite theme page bg

500.$description: proposed — 8px scale rung between PR 24 and 36

700.$description: PR #2204 wrap calc sides total 48px desktop; .split/.section-head gaps ~40–50

full.$description: PR #2204 pills / .live-dot circle (999 token for full)

heavy.$description: PR #2204 kickers/status; PR also uses 750/760 which map to Extra Bold in Figma

standard.$description: proposed equivalent of PR #2204 `ease` (CSS ease ~ cubic-bezier(0.25,0.1,0.25,1))

0.$description: PR implicit flat default (cards have no shadow until hover)

semantic.$description: Aliases to primitives only. Theme modes live here. Customer Design DNA may add extra modes that override ONLY these semantic tokens.

default.$description: Page background. light-cream uses proposed cream; pure-white-silver uses PR --paper; warm-graphite uses proposed warm paper.

paper.$description: Raised paper / card on default surface. proposed cream-raised / PR white.

subtle.$description: Subtle recessed surface. proposed cream-deep / PR --bg.

muted.$description: Muted card surface. PR #2204 .section-white .card #fafbfc in light-cream.

tint.$description: Accent-tinted surface. PR --soft in light-cream; proposed metal-light / cream-deep in other modes.

accent.$description: Accent text (h1 em, kickers). PR --blue in light-cream; metal / graphite in other modes.

primary.$description: Theme-switching primary accent. PR --blue / proposed metal / PR cta-bg.

blue.$description: Reserved blue highlight (use sparingly). PR #2204 --blue. Same in all modes.
